description: An object literal that stores a function value fires E-VALUE-FUNCTION-STORED (§14.3, §15.11.5.1). `{ double: twice }` holds the declared function `twice` in a field: a function is not value data (no structural equality, not serializable, cannot be a map key), so no value holds one. Incidental W-PROGRAM-SPA-INFERRED is ignored by superset matching.
provenance: ruling:user-voice-scrml.md S462 "a" (no value holds a function) + S464 "(a) Migrate the tests"
rationale: §14.3 the STORED prohibition governs every value, not only a function-typed field annotation: an object / array / map literal holding a function is the hard error E-VALUE-FUNCTION-STORED. Pass the function to the call that uses it, wire it as a prop / handler, or store an enum tag and match on it.
